questions

good to know.

Which areas do you cover?

We're based in South West London and cover the whole of London, including Battersea, Clapham, Wandsworth, Putney, Fulham, Chelsea and beyond.

Are you insured and vetted?

Yes. We're fully insured and every member of our team is vetted, so your property is in safe hands.

How quickly can you book me in?

We take bookings instantly. Send us your details on WhatsApp and we'll confirm a date as quickly as possible.

What kinds of cleaning do you do?

End of tenancy, deep cleans, after builders cleans, regular home cleans and commercial or office cleaning. Just pick the one you need in the quote form.
